_comment: PLANTPOTTING-0007 + PLANTPOTTING-0009 — maps the House Plant Species (47-class) MobileNetV2 model labels to KB speciesIds. Labels are the model's exact output-index order (see labels.csv); runtime lookup is EXACT-MATCH on the verbatim label string (including any parenthetical). PLANTPOTTING-0009 added 16 delta species: coverage is now 26 of 47 model classes (was 10). Coarse rows (alias:true with a _note) map a broader model class onto the KB's single representative species; routing honesty still applies (a coarse high-confidence hit maps, a weak one routes low-confidence). The 16 new mappings are editorial/model-vocabulary coverage only — NOT calibrated with real-photo probes (known gap). 'Rattlesnake Plant (Calathea lancifolia)' is deliberately NOT mapped to goeppertia-orbifolia (different Calathea species). 'Chinese Money Plant (Pilea peperomioides)' is deliberately LEFT UNMAPPED this sprint — it ships in a later sprint bundled with the pothos<->Pilea boundary fix so a wrong-but-confident card cannot surface. See docs/kb/ml-mapping-notes.md.

Snake plant (Sanseviera)._note: Snake plant / Sansevieria trifasciata == Dracaena trifasciata

Orchid._note: COARSE: model class 'Orchid' is broader than the KB's Phalaenopsis; mapped because Phalaenopsis is the KB's only (and the most common houseplant) orchid. Flagged in ml-mapping-notes.

Calathea._note: COARSE/genus: Goeppertia orbifolia was formerly Calathea orbifolia; the model's generic 'Calathea' class is mapped to the KB's only Calathea/Goeppertia. The separate 'Rattlesnake Plant (Calathea lancifolia)' class is intentionally left unmapped (different species).

Chinese evergreen (Aglaonema)._note: COARSE/genus: model class 'Chinese evergreen (Aglaonema)' mapped to the KB's representative Aglaonema entry (PLANTPOTTING-0009).

Elephant Ear (Alocasia spp.)._note: COARSE/genus: model class 'Elephant Ear (Alocasia spp.)' mapped to the KB's representative Alocasia entry (PLANTPOTTING-0009).

Dumb Cane (Dieffenbachia spp.)._note: COARSE/genus: model class 'Dumb Cane (Dieffenbachia spp.)' mapped to the KB's representative Dieffenbachia entry (PLANTPOTTING-0009).

Kalanchoe._note: COARSE/genus: bare model class 'Kalanchoe' mapped to the KB's representative Kalanchoe entry (PLANTPOTTING-0009).

Dracaena._note: COARSE/genus: bare model class 'Dracaena' mapped to the KB's tree-form Dracaena (marginata/fragrans) entry. The succulent snake plant stays separately mapped to 'dracaena-trifasciata' via 'Snake plant (Sanseviera)' (PLANTPOTTING-0009).

Tradescantia._note: COARSE/genus: bare model class 'Tradescantia' mapped to the KB's representative Tradescantia entry (PLANTPOTTING-0009).

Schefflera._note: COARSE/genus: bare model class 'Schefflera' mapped to the KB's representative Schefflera entry (PLANTPOTTING-0009).
